features.title: Living shield
features.text: Guardians wear medium or heavy armor to resist physical damage and stay close enough to protect their allies.

features.title: Taunt and intercept
features.text: Taunt penalizes enemies that attack allies instead of the guardian. Intercept Attack lets a guardian step beside a nearby ally and take physical damage in their place.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2.5 → 2.5. Personal damage is secondary to protection; do not credit intercepted damage as offense.
ratings.defense: 5 → 5. Armor and mitigation make personal durability a core strength.
ratings.support: 3.5 → 4–5. Intercepting attacks and redirecting enemy attention protect allies; build and positioning govern coverage.
ratings.utility: 1.5 → 1.5. The base class focuses on combat protection, with few extra exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Threat assessment, positioning and deciding when to take an ally's hit require judgment.
